excluded: integration with vLLM or another inference server

authority_boundary.machine_role: propose an ordered list of evictable block identifiers
authority_boundary.human_readable_role: validate identities, uniqueness, liveness, capacity, and fallback safety before mutating state

hard_invariants: resident block count never exceeds the declared capacity
one group and cache key pair maps to exactly one physical block
a block with live owners is never evicted
duplicate and unknown victim identifiers are rejected
request completion and cancellation release every live owner reference
checkpoint restore is bound to the selected policy identity
the same trace and policy identity produce the same final state digest
invalid machine proposals fall back without corrupting cache state
